view: PA (frontal), erect; "L" side marker at image upper-right corner confirms conventional orientation (patient left on image right)
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration, minimal rotation, both costophrenic angles included, apices included. Lower zones slightly dense from overlying breast/soft tissue but spine visible through the heart; mildly under-penetrated abdomen.

devices.location: Image upper-right corner, outside the thorax over the patient's left shoulder

devices.type: External artifact (clothing/gown fold or strap edge, ribbed soft-tissue density)
devices.location: Image lower-right edge, patient's left lower lateral chest wall/flank, outside the lung fields

abnormalities.finding: Hyperlucent upper lung zones with attenuated/paucity of peripheral vascular markings and widened intercostal spaces, consistent with emphysematous change (diffuse, upper-zone predominant)
Prominent aortic knob with unfolded/tortuous thoracic aorta; widened superior mediastinum with convex right paratracheal contour, likely ectatic ascending aorta
Elevated, rounded right hemidiaphragm (possible eventration), higher than the left by roughly 2 rib spaces
Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal / borderline cardiomegaly with elongated left ventricular contour
Prominent bibasilar bronchovascular markings, possibly chronic bronchitic change
Degenerative changes of the thoracic and lower cervical spine (osteophytes, sclerosis)

description_zh: PA 立位胸部X光片，影像右上角可見 L 側標，方向為常規擺位。雙側上肺野透亮度增加、周邊血管紋理稀疏且肋間隙增寬，符合肺氣腫改變；雙下肺野支氣管血管紋理略增粗。主動脈弓突出、胸主動脈迂曲延展，上縱膈於右側氣管旁輪廓外凸（疑升主動脈延展），心影大小約在正常上限。右側橫膈膜明顯抬高呈圓弧狀，胸椎可見退化性變化；未見胸管、引流管或任何植入裝置，僅影像右下緣可見衣物等體外偽影。
